item.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

item.tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

answer_sheet.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

**Cheapest recommendation:** make a 9-second photo slideshow in Instagram or a free editor, with gentle pan/zoom, exact text overlays and music licensed for business use. That uses **0 Magic Hour credits**, preserves your actual photos, and doesn’t need to be shorter.

turns.agent:
Here’s a **zero–Magic Hour-credit** way to make it in a free video editor such as CapCut. Use only free effects and export options.

### 1. Set up the reel
- Create a project with a **9:16 vertical canvas**.
- Add the photos in this order:

| Time | Photo | Text |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 sec | Storefront | **Maple Street Café** |
| 3–6 sec | Latte | None |
| 6–9 sec | Pastries | **Your morning starts here** |

Set each photo to exactly **3 seconds**.

### 2. Frame the photos
- **Storefront:** Keep the full café frontage visible. Because the photo is wide, use a softly blurred copy as the background rather than cropping away most of the shop.
- **Latte:** Centre the cup and saucer, with a matching blurred background if needed.
- **Pastries:** Fill the vertical frame, keeping the croissants prominent.

### 3. Add gentle movement
Use a slow zoom on each photo—roughly **100% to 105%** over its three seconds. In editors with keyframes, set the starting scale at the beginning and the slightly larger scale at the end.

Keep simple cuts between photos; no paid transitions needed.

### 4. Style the titles
Add the wording as **editable text overlays**, not AI-generated lettering:
- Warm white or cream text
- A clean serif or rounded font
- A subtle dark shadow for readability
- Keep text away from the bottom and right edges, where Instagram’s controls appear

Show each title for its full three-second photo.

### 5. Add music
Choose a **soft, upbeat instrumental**—gentle acoustic guitar or light piano—with no vocals. Trim it to nine seconds and add a short fade-out.

**For your café promotion, use a track explicitly cleared for business/promotional use.** Don’t assume every song available in an editor or Instagram is cleared for that purpose.

### 6. Export
- **MP4, 1080 × 1920, 30 fps** for a standard Reel
- Or **720 × 1280** for a smaller file

**Magic Hour credits used: 0.** No AI generation is needed, and your photos and title spelling stay intact.
